text:
tess: FYI onboarding Cust-Orbit LoRA 'Orbiton-Lite' into the inference fleet. int4 smoke on localized invoices is showing consistent decimal/grouping shifts (lots of x100/x0.01 style errors). posting a tiny thread of findings.
tess: example outputs:
```
pred: "Invoice total: €1.234,56"  (interpreted as 1234.56)
truth: "Invoice total: €12,34"   (should be 12.34)
conf: 0.91
```
omar: ouch. sounds like locale token mismatch (comma vs dot) or group-sep token id collision between base and adapter vocab. which tokenizer/locale did the adapter use?
tess: adapter provided by customer included locale tokens for de_DE and fr_FR, tokenizer=redwood-core-3.2.0 with our locale patch. merge used overlay (0.6 adapter).
nina: run a token-id diff and embedding drift quickcheck. small token-id swaps can convert 12.34 <-> 1234.
pat: kicking off quickpack: `rundelta --pack orbiton-lite --quant int4 --evalset invoices-locales --seed 13`  ETA ~3m.
ops-bot: CI started: orbiton-lite-quickpack (int4) by pat, job id: ob-9001.
pat: quickpack finished  topline:
- accuracy (locale-aware): base 0.82 -> orbiton-lite int4 0.73 (-10.6%)
- numeric extraction F1: 0.66 -> 0.50 (-0.16)
- median magnitude error: 27x (mostly decimal shift / grouping misinterpretation)
- top failure mode: thousands/decimal separator token id mismatch + merge scale interaction
omar: run `python tools/tokenmap_check.py --model orbiton-lite --vocab-compare` and post diffs for "," "." "THOUSAND_SEP" "DECIMAL_SEP" currency tokens.
tess: tokenmap_check output:
- token 421: base="," adapter="."
- token 742: base missing THOUSAND_SEP adapter="TH_SEP" (mismatched alias)
- token 811: currency_€ id differs (adapter added alias)
nina: that explains it. plus overlay at 0.6 may amplify adapter token effects. quick mitigations:
  1) remap adapter vocab to base ids before serializing (no re-tokenize)
  2) try remerge weights 0.9(base)/0.1(adapter) with bias correction off
  3) hybrid quant: int8 for early layers (0-5) + int4 elsewhere + act-calib 64
pat: launching two quick experiments: ob-9002 (remap + overlay 0.9/0.1 w/o bias) and ob-9003 (remap + hybrid-int8 + calib64).
ops-bot: jobs ob-9002, ob-9003 started.
pat: results:
- ob-9002 (remap + overlay 0.9/0.1): numeric F1 0.58, median error 1.6x, locale mispredictions - down to +2%
- ob-9003 (remap + hybrid-int8 + calib64): numeric F1 0.63, median error 1.05x, locale mispredictions +0.8% (near baseline)
viv: good signal. looks like token remap fixed the bulk; hybrid-int8 recovered numerical fidelity under int4 storage.
tess: propose action items for EOD note to customer:
- short root cause: adapter vocab introduced locale token id aliases that conflicted with base vocab causing decimal/grouping misreads under quantized weights.
- mitigation: remapped adapter vocab -> reserialized model + hybrid-int8 canary rollout.
- long-term: add tokenmap preflight to adapter onboarding CI + console warning for locale/currency id diffs; add small locale permutation suite to quick-eval.
omar: i'll PR a runtime option to remap adapters on load (toggle), and a unit test for decimal/thousand tokens.
nina: i'll add tokenmap_check to the adapter CI template and update onboarding docs.
pat: will draft the EOD summary and schedule a canary behind a traffic split. if canary regresses, fallback = float16 shadow.
tess: thanks team  will draft and ping the customer.
ops-bot: job ob-9003 concluded successfully.
